_about: A52-3 (user 2026-10-28): nong's own skeleton from a camera, like YOLO pose. Keypoints sit on Studio's rig bodies (tools/nong_sim NongTree), so a rig change moves them. Offsets are mm in the body's frame (Studio frame: Y up, robot's left +X, front +Z) and may use the rig's dims and headR/handY/handH/handW. Read by tools/robot_pose.

keypoints.name: chest_front
keypoints.why: front marker: only seen from the front, tells front from back

keypoints.name: L_hand_edge
keypoints.why: the paddle's outer edge: shows the forearm roll (EL_R), which the tip alone cannot

leftRight: L_/R_ name prefixes are swapped for a mirrored image (YOLO flip_idx) and tried swapped by the fitter

facing._about: yaw of the robot's front seen from the camera, degrees: 0 = faces the camera

labels.th: หันซ้ายให้กล้อง
หันขวาให้กล้อง

camera._about: first guess for a camera never calibrated; the fit refines it. lab 2026-10-28: PC webcam 0, 640x480 ~30 fps

fit._priorWeight: pull (per degree, in pixels) toward the start pose, so a joint the view cannot see stays put
fit._swapMargin: left/right swapped is believed only when its error is below this share of the unswapped
fit._seenWeight: pixels of penalty per mm a seenFrom:front keypoint is more than seenMarginMm on the wrong side of the neck (seen but behind, or unseen inside the picture but in front)
fit._restarts: a frame whose fit is worse than restartPx (rms) is fitted again from this many random poses; the best wins

calibrate._zeroFixed: a waist zero error looks exactly like the camera standing elsewhere (nothing else on the robot is fixed to the floor), so it is not fitted
calibrate._about: suggestions only: nothing is written to the rig (user 2026-10-23: axes, senses, zero and home are tuned to the real robot)

detector._about: a YOLO pose model trained on synth + lab frames (handoff/tasks/robot-pose-data.md); optional: needs `pip install ultralytics`
